Ms Venn – update before close of office. Safety first: please do not use the plug-in heater whose casing becomes unusually hot (the heating engineer has advised against using it) and do not attempt to investigate or restart the boiler yourself. Keep one room as warm as you can, close internal doors, and keep curtains closed; you still have hot water. If you smell gas at any time, leave the property, do not touch electrical switches, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.

A Gas Safe heating engineer has been instructed on an emergency basis for the cancellation slot on 15 January, 09:00–11:00, which you confirmed you could cover (your message of 12:14). The engineer has been asked to phone you directly at least 30 minutes before arrival and to call from outside; we have told them only that you need extra time to answer the door — no medical details have been shared. We are not using 17 January because of your hospital appointment.

On staying with your niece tonight, heater delivery or transport: our duty manager is handling this now and will call you this evening. Please let us know whether your niece's entrance is step-free, and call us straight away if you feel unwell or the cold becomes unmanageable.
